competitions.title: “All In” for New Business — District 49 Texas Hold ‘Em Promo
competitions.description: Five weeks to build your hand, September 14 through October 16. Two bars to clear for a seat at the table: 40 quotes every week (or 250 total across the five weeks) and 20 NB policies — policies, not units. Each bar is one card, so clearing both deals you two. Then every additional 50 quotes past 250 earns another card and every additional 5 NB policies past 20 earns another, with no limit — 350 quotes and 32 policies is six cards. No ante and no buy-in: the district office funds the full $1,000 pot and cash is the only prize. We play one hand of Texas Hold ‘Em at the showdown on Thursday, October 22, at happy hour in the district office right after the 1:00–4:00 district meeting; you do not need to be there to win. Best five-card hand from your own cards plus the five community cards takes 40% of the pot, then 25%, 20%, 10% and 5% for second through fifth. The DM Performance Tracker is the official report; disputes are settled at the District Manager’s discretion. Live cards and seats are on the District 49 board above.

competitions.title: “All In” for Life — District 32 Texas Hold ‘Em Life Promo
competitions.prize: Cash pot — top five hands paid
competitions.description: A District 32 promo. A $50 ante and 3 written life apps earns your seat at the table, and every life app written earns an additional playing card — the more apps you write, the better your odds of a great poker hand. We play one hand of Texas Hold ‘Em: best hand takes 40% of the pot, then 25%, 20%, 10% and 5% for second through fifth. Antes go straight into the pot and the district office adds $1,000, rising to $2,500 once the district writes 85 total apps. Write your 3 apps and take none of the pot and your $50 ante is refunded. Apps must show on the Life Performance Tracker and be written August 31 – September 30 to count. Commitment and ante are due by September 4 — checks payable to Brandon Parks at the district office, 213A Old Hewitt Road, Waco, TX 76712. Disputes are settled at the District Manager’s discretion. Live seats, the pot, and everyone’s cards are on the September Competitions dashboard — open it from Resources.

competitions.title: Steak or Burgers — District 32 Team Quote & NB Battle
competitions.prize: Prime steak for the winning team; burgers for the rest
competitions.description: Every District 32 agency is on one of two teams for September, and scoring is by points at the agency level: each quote is worth 1 point and each new business policy is worth 5, counted for September 1–30. The team with the most points eats Prime steak; the other team gets burgers. The teams are set: Team Alan (14 agencies) takes on Team Conrey (15), drawn to be as evenly matched as possible on summer production. Full rosters and live team scores are on the September Competitions dashboard — open it from Resources or the news post below. The cookout happens after the October district meeting.

competitions.title: Summer Surprise — District 32 Weekly Cash Promo
competitions.prize: Venmo cash to the week's top 5 — $100 / $60 / $40 / $25 / $25
competitions.description: The Summer Surprise runs in District 32 too, on the same calendar as District 49: weeks 3 through 13, September 12 through November 27 (Saturday-to-Friday reporting weeks — weeks 1 and 2 ran July 4–17 before the pause). Each week the district office announces the top 5 producers for the week by quotes or by NB policies. Eight of the promo's thirteen weeks pay immediate Venmo cash — $100, $60, $40, $25 and $25 for first through fifth — and the rest are “atta boy” weeks. Nobody knows which weeks pay or whether the week is scored on quotes or NB until it is announced, by the Wednesday after the week closes, so hustle every week. Policies must be written in the producer code and during the promo period; results come from the PL NBA Producer Report; Foremost PAR commissions credit as received; only P&C licensed and appointed staff are eligible; disputes are settled by the District Manager. Live weekly top-5 lists by quotes and by NB are on the District 32 board above.

competitions.metricLabel: YTD life as of Sep 6 · qualifiers first, then premium
competitions.description: Qualify with $45,000 life premium and 20 I&P. Agents who I&P $70,000 in life premium also bring an agency producer and their guest. Travel likely Jan/Feb 2027. Standings are year-to-date issued-and-paid premium and counts from the district's YTD Life Results as of September 6, listed with qualifiers first and then by premium. Steven Tindell and Jeffrey Pechacek have cleared both bars; Tindell is $1,620 from the $70,000 producer-and-guest tier. Matt Hodges has the premium and is 2 I&P away. FNWL reports are the official source for tracking and disputes are settled at the District Manager's discretion. No cash in lieu, no refunds or credits if the trip is not taken, and the agent must be in good standing with Farmers at the time of travel.
